steps.name: the dev server makes the browser check every file again, so a new module never meets a stale cached one
steps.js: Promise.all(['/', '/assets/css/site.css', '/assets/js/page.js', '/assets/js/engine/shaders.js'].map(u => fetch(u, { cache: 'no-store' }).then(r => r.headers.get('cache-control')))).then(a => a.every(h => h === 'no-cache'))
